description: Defines the 'Field' struct used within Orleans.Serialization.WireProtocol for representing a field header in serialization. Includes properties for tags, field identifiers, field types, and related methods for validation and string representation.

classes.name: Field
classes.description: Represents a field header with properties for tag, field identifiers, type, wire type, schema type, and methods for validation, string representation, and manipulation.

methods.name: Field(Tag)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Field with a Tag.

methods.name: Field(Tag, uint, Type)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Field with a Tag, extended field id delta, and a type.

methods.name: FieldIdDelta
methods.description: Gets or sets the field identifier delta, with validation and tagging logic.

methods.name: FieldType
methods.description: Gets or sets the type of the field with validation.

methods.name: EnsureWireTypeTagDelimited
methods.description: Ensures that the wire type is TagDelimited; throws if not.

methods.name: EnsureWireType
methods.description: Ensures that the wire type matches the expected type; throws if not.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Provides string representation of the 'Field' struct, including various properties.
